==Airlines and destinations==
[[File:AC Rouge 767 at YYJ.jpg|thumb|Air Canada Rouge Boeing 767-300 at Victoria (CYYJ), July 2017]]

Most commercial flights at Victoria fly either to airports in nearby [[British Columbia]] and [[Alberta]] or to western [[Washington (state)|Washington]]. Seasonal scheduled flights by [[WestJet]] connect Victoria to tourist destinations in Mexico. For the Summer 2017 season, [[Air Canada Rouge]] operated wide-body [[Boeing 767]]s on its daily flights to [[Toronto Pearson International Airport|Toronto]].
